rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for bread as a baked cereal food.

example.english: I usually eat bread for breakfast.
example.traditional: 我朝早通常食麵包做早餐。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 tung1 soeng4 sik6 min6 baau1 zou6 zou2 caan1

rows.note: A speaker uses 包 for a bread roll or bun, rather than bread as the general food category.

example.english: I bought two buns of bread to eat at the office.
example.traditional: 我買咗兩個包返公司食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 go3 baau1 faan1 gung1 si1 sik6
